title: curv-block-discard: curvature discarded by block-diagonal preconditioning
description: Scientific software and author-owned experimental records accompanying the manuscript Profile-aware diagnostics of discarded parameter-Hessian mass. The study compares parameter-Hessian mass with size/profile references and explicit partitions, with separate bounded correction and finite-step diagnostics. Code and author-owned records are MIT-licensed. Third-party datasets, model weights and dependencies retain their own terms. No deposit, DOI or publication is implied.
